versions.changelog:
- Initial release of LinkedIn Ads Strategy skill for B2B campaigns.
- Provides detailed guidance on targeting options, ad formats, and optimizing for high-LTV B2B products.
- Includes recommendations for campaign structure, funnel alignment, and bidding strategies.
- Covers all major LinkedIn ad types: Sponsored Content, Document Ads, Video, Message Ads, Lead Gen Forms, and Thought Leader Ads.
- Emphasizes audience size requirements and decision frameworks for when to use LinkedIn vs. other platforms.
